_notes: Four posts a week: Monday, Wednesday, Friday, Sunday. Stories on the days between.
Ground is one of: cocoa, oxblood, powder, cream, stripe. Never two of the same touching in the grid.
Entries with a 'tile' object are type led and are generated by npm run tiles. No camera needed.
Captions are linted. See tests/captions.test.mjs for what fails.

weeks.note: No product reveal. Earn the follow before asking for anything.

posts.headline: The line, alone on a dark ground
posts.caption:
Rest is the greatest gift.

We are a small studio in Melbourne making one very good sleep box, and a few silk masks. Follow along. We open this month.

posts.headline: Silk, close enough to see the weave
posts.shoot: Pillowcase folded in thirds, raking side light, cream ground. Sell the material before the product.
posts.caption:
Grade 6A mulberry silk at 22 momme. Heavy enough to drape properly, and heavy enough to survive being washed for years.

Everything in the box had to feel like this against a warm cheek at 2am.

posts.headline: Hands smoothing a pillowcase
posts.shoot: One shot. No talking, no trending audio, ambient room sound. Cover styled as an oxblood type tile so the grid holds.
posts.caption: The last thing you do before the light goes off.

posts.headline: Waitlist open
posts.caption: The list is open, link in bio. First boxes leave Melbourne this month.

weeks.note: Reveal. The Monday hero here is the image that will run as your ad and your homepage banner.

posts.headline: Closed, ribbon tied, overhead
posts.shoot: Shoot this one properly. It is the ad, the banner and the grid anchor. Straight overhead, powder ground, oxblood ribbon.
posts.caption:
The Signature Sleep Box. Eight pieces, chosen so you do not have to assemble a gift yourself.

$149, free shipping Australia wide, packed by hand in Fitzroy.

posts.headline: One item per slide
posts.shoot: Each on a different ground: cocoa, powder, cream, repeat. Item name in display type. No prices on the slides.
posts.caption:
Swipe for everything inside.

Mulberry silk eye mask. Silk pillowcase. Matching silk scrunchie. Bed socks. Pillow mist. Herbal tea. A small candle. A journal for the bedside table.

posts.headline: Unboxing in real time
posts.shoot: Ribbon pull, tissue open, lid off, one item lifted out. No sped up footage, no captions on screen.
posts.caption: What arrives at their door.

posts.headline: Eight pieces, one ritual
posts.shoot: Nothing. Generated tile. Use this line on the box sleeve too so print and feed match.
posts.caption: Not a hamper. Not a candle with a bow on it. Eight pieces that were chosen against each other.

weeks.note: Changed from the original plan. The masks now exist and they are the cheapest way in, so they get a week rather than a mention.

posts.headline: The silk mask, flat, side lit
posts.shoot: Show the covered strap and the outside seam. Those are the two things nobody else does and both photograph.
posts.caption:
The seam sits on the outside, so nothing rests against your eyelid. The strap is covered along its whole length, so it does not catch in hair.

Small things. They are the whole reason this one took a year.

posts.headline: Four masks, four reasons
posts.shoot: One mask per slide, each on its own ground. Silk, weighted, contoured, travel.
posts.caption:
Four masks now. Silk for most people. Weighted at 180 grams if you like the feel of something there. Contoured if you want to open your eyes underneath it. Travel if it lives in a bag.

From $49, link in bio.

posts.headline: Cutting and finishing a strap
posts.shoot: The bench, close, hands only. Slight speed up is fine here.
posts.caption: Every strap is covered by hand. It is the slowest part of making a mask and the first thing you would notice if we skipped it.

posts.headline: Give the most important thing
posts.caption:
Give the most important thing.

The box is $149. The silk mask on its own is $49. Both leave Melbourne the same afternoon if you order before the cut-off.

weeks.note: Launch week. The Monday post gets pinned to the top of the profile.

posts.headline: Now open
posts.shoot: Same hero as week two, reshot at a different angle so it is not a repost. Pin this one.
posts.caption:
Sleep Shop is open.

The Signature Sleep Box, $149. Silk masks from $49. Shipping across Australia, packed by hand in Melbourne. Link in bio.

posts.headline: The gift card, being written
posts.shoot: Hand, pen, card at an angle. The single most persuasive shot you own, because it is the thing they cannot do from a supermarket.
posts.caption:
Tell us what to write and we write it by hand before the lid goes on.

Up to 250 characters, exactly as you type it, line breaks and all.

posts.headline: The first orders going out
posts.shoot: Stack of boxes, labels on, the door of the post office. Real, slightly rough. Do not over polish this one.
posts.caption: The first boxes are on their way. Thank you, genuinely.

posts.headline: Week one, closed
posts.caption:
Thank you for a first week we did not expect. More boxes packed this week.

If you were waiting on a colour, it is back on the site.
